notes: MMR-261 (docs/magic-ground.md 'Live mutation'; findings section 7; RT-37): the runtime landscape mutation. Module-embedded, not a compiler input and not in the re-pin chain. A MagicEvent {school, settlement, strength} adds strength to the (settlement, school) residue at the next daily batch; a residue at or above residueThreshold emits one LeylineEdit at the capital rule's site (the FWGC++ capital of the event settlement's member realm while its kingdom holds it, else the ruling house's home, else the event settlement) and drops by the threshold. The first edit at a site plants a key point of firstIntensity; each later one raises it by intensityStep up to maxIntensity. All values are starting values (MMR-247's balance pass).
